action_summary: Derive the provably minimal sufficient sense for a plan's premise instead of hand-listing sense vocabularies, and price it, reusing the tree's exact decision-refinement compiler verified against an independent brute force.
blocker_lease_key: 2026-10-09-resource-bounded-bytes-v1::GENERAL_REUSABLE_PROBLEM_SOLVING_CAPABILITY_FRONTIER::The tree named the bottleneck correctly -- whether the fact a plan depends on is observable at the moment of acting -- and then hand-listed four sense vocabularies to test it. That answers 'is a rich sense better than a poor one' (always yes) but not 'which facts are minimally sufficient, and what do they cost'. The question is exactly solvable: a plan is one choice (RUN+CONFIRM where it reaches the goal, REFUSE where it does not), two states may share a perception only if they agree on that choice, so the minimal sufficient sense is the minimum-cost fact set making every cell decision-consistent. Measured on the tree's real git world: task A needs the single fact 'unstaged' (cost 1) and task C needs the single fact 'content:b.txt' (cost 1), both making 0 states undecidable, while the richest hand-listed sense reads 11 facts for the same answer and the six-fact status sense is NOT sufficient for task C at all (24 undecidable states). More sensing was never the answer; the right sensing was. This is the exchange the architecture needs and did not have: read exactly the premise, refuse when it fails.

falsification_condition: A task whose minimal sufficient sense is not sufficient in practice, or a case where a sense with fewer facts is sufficient than the compiler selects, would refute either the formulation or the compiler's optimality. Disagreement between the compiler and the independent brute force is treated as a failure of this module, not of the compiler; they agree on both tasks measured.

route_frontier.negative_search_summary: Two routes were refused on this tree's own measurement, not on taste. (1) RANK HARDER over the observed pool: contrast_selection_v1 is already exact and returned NO_INFORMATIVE_STATE with 8,388,600 survivors on the tree's real corpus, so the failure is population, not ordering. (2) INVENT A STATE FREELY: contrast_selection_v1 refuses to leave the observed pool for a measured reason (queries outside the generator's support), and certified_reached_escape_state_constructor_v2 exists precisely to bind any certified row to a separately supplied verifier; a state that cannot be reached is the wild guess the selector is right to refuse. The web adds the mechanism, not a dominator: observationally equivalent models need not agree under intervention because interventions create inputs that never occur in observational data (arXiv 2609.32247), and active interventional agents beat active observational ones only where a confounder is present (arXiv 1901.08162). Neither supplies a reachable-state constructor for THIS tree.
